name: Board truck / pull-back to the board
lesson: Facts sit at fixed spots on one board and the camera trucks between them in ≈6 f with motion blur (drift on holds); or a pull-back reveals the shot was a page/printed photo: 4 f jitter, 1 defocused frame, 3 f zoom-out to a page tilted ≈15°.

name: Still camera on holds (kiblat)
lesson: The kiblat keeps the camera locked on holds (alive 17 %, IQR 5–22 % in kiblat v2 of 41 videos; v1 8–37 %) and lets the elements move; drift is for cinematic/character recipes.

name: Chapter frame + hourglass pacing
lesson: Calm minimal type at the start and end (shots 4–9 s), a very fast middle (0.2–0.8 s clips) held inside a rounded screen card with a chapter tag and a thin progress bar, so the eye has a frame while content races; 1–2 black frames between clips.

name: The cursor is the actor
lesson: A hand or text cursor triggers every change: drag stretches a button into a pill (14 f) with the fill colour following the value, a selection box sweeps the key word (6 f), a typing cursor deletes the line, the film ends as a selected word shrinking into an I-beam.

name: Seamless loop
lesson: Open and close on the same element (a blue dot, four grid lines, a window that grows to become frame 1) so the edit loops on the platform without a seam.

name: Strip accordion / word-bar sandwich
lesson: Every 2 beats (≈0.9 s) each of 4 photo strips slides 15–20 % of the frame in ≈6 f expo-out and the strip heights change; or word bars split apart in ≈5 f so photo strips slide into the gaps.

name: The word becomes the UI
lesson: A word of the sentence turns into the UI component (input pill in 4 f, then typed into); a pill stretches into the input bar in 3 f; a button is a portal (3-f push until its fill is the next field, label kept as headline); an icon stretches into a card in 10 f with its glyph sliding to the corner as a badge; the frame shrinks into a pin in 11–12 f.

name: Paper boil on twos
lesson: Collage held elements jitter ±2°/frame, tape letters rebuilt one stroke per frame, motion on 2s (50–62 % held frames), a 1-step ×1.15–1.3 scale pop before a cut. Brightness boil ≤ 2 L: a 10–14 L paper boil made 3 impacts and 5 flashes/s in the reference.

name: Click chain (one spot, many states)
lesson: Each click pales the component 1–2 f, then it blurs and reshapes in 3–6 f into the next component in the same spot; six states in a row with no cut; content inside a box lags 2–3 f.

name: Organic colour flood
lesson: The next field arrives as paint, not a wipe: soft bloom in 4 f, brush/liquid wipe in the next field's colour (4 f), colour or warm light flooding up from the bottom (5 f), a word turning into spray dust that grows into the field (7 f).

name: Value flip under a fixed anchor
lesson: Every cut flips white ↔ black while the centre object keeps its place and changes identity (logo → button → dot → orb → logo); variants: grey dip L≈50 for 2–3 f with directional blur (7–9 f total), light→dark map mode under a fixed pin (5–9 f), horizon band sliding down in 4 f.

name: Caret / decode type-on
lesson: Type-on at 1–2 f per letter with a caret, or decode in ≈4 f (random order for titles, ≈7 f); monospace typewriter columns in collage, the host UI's own font in UI-native lyric edits.

name: Exponential portal zoom with flow words
lesson: Worlds nested ×10 per bar inside each other's portal; Z = exp(∫r dt) tabulated, r eased in/out only at the ends; every world vector-redrawn at its own scale (never a raster scale). Lyrics are placed when sung on compass slots (top, right, bottom, left) around the current portal, stream out with the zoom, fade after ~2× growth; ink follows the field behind. motion-eye scores it low (1 shot, burst 100 %, no holds) by construction.

films.evidence: dive test SKOR 52 (contrast Δ78, mud 2 %); posters 80-94

name: Satellite dive on a real map
lesson: Camera = {target, distance, pitch, heading, lens shift}; distance interpolates in log space with a sin hop for long jumps (rises, then dives), ease bezier(0.72,0,0.12,1) leaves slow and brakes hard in 0.3-0.42 s, 8 sub-frames + zoom blur + CA only while moving, a push-in drift on holds, and a 4.5 % stepped push-in on every slam word.

films.evidence: v1: kamera hidup saat hold 44 %, 0 big eye jumps

name: Kinetic name + dive on the keyword
lesson: On the spoken name: letters fly in from x2.4 with a 1-frame stagger, smeared along their travel, tracking collapsing 1.5x->1x; the base layer dives 1->1.3 into the window (0.13 s in, 0.47 s out) with a moderate radial zoom blur + CA/barrel only while fast; the last letter's landing bumps the card and shakes the camera 3 frames. Type and caption stay out of the dive so they stay readable.
source: Ikhsan v1 note: 'skill film motion supermu mana'

films.evidence: v2: SKOR 84 (v1 80), focus 10/10, 0 1-frame impacts

name: Paste-up type on a multiplane camera
lesson: Words are cut-paper labels/chips pasted (expo 16 in 6 f, flutter spring T 0.28 ζ 0.55, shadow shrinks as they land) onto paper layers at depths; per-layer scale = D0/(D0-dolly-z) gives parallax and DOF for free; held paper boils on twos.

films.evidence: video-7 posters 8/8 >= 70 on hook and full film

name: Slit-scan zoom entrance
lesson: A hero flies in from a larger scale through 14 radial time bands (D 0.12-0.34 s): the bands catch it at different scales and it tears into teeth, then locks whole on the sung word. Start at <= ~3x: from 7x the O alone filled the frame light-on-red and the film hit 4 flashes/s (WCAG limit 3).

films.evidence: video-8 SOS at 24.17-24.6 s: kedip maks 4/s at 7x -> 1/s at 3.2x

name: HDR panel room for PBR metal and stones
lesson: Metal lit only by an HDR room of emissive panels (>1.0) via PMREM. Faces that look at the lens reflect what is BEHIND the camera: gold needs a paned warm window there, chrome a wide soft sky (±48°), brilliants a black room with a mosaic of medium cards + tiny hot ones (a transmission stone on an empty background renders grey plastic).

films.evidence: G1 posters 88-100 (PATEK, FAME, 100,000, octagon); gold went from black/brown to gold once the window was behind the camera; G1 board approved ('lanjutkannn oke semua')

name: Slit-scan as 'learning to see'
lesson: Each of N horizontal bands shows the layer at t - Dt*j/(N-1) (N 14-18, Dt 0.22-0.32 s): a moving word/strip shears through time and becomes whole when it holds. Max 3 uses per film (eyes, watching renders, the CTA callback).

films.evidence: video-7: EYES. styleframe poster 100

name: Watch tick locked to the song
lesson: (floor(t) + pow(frac, 0.2)) * angle with a damped escapement recoil, t in song beats; each wheel advances one tooth per tick (360/teeth, alternating direction); a lyric beat changes the rate (x4 on 'goin nuts', a 4-tick slip on 'slippin').

films.evidence: SF2 poster 100; G1 approved

name: Spring-lagged gravity cable
lesson: A cable between moving boxes = konsep's createPath ([p1, mid, p2], tangents ±dist·0.15 at mid, sag dist·0.25); the mid point follows its ends through the convolution of a spring step response (T 0.55, ζ 0.28: lags, overshoots, rings), beat kicks shake it sideways, a white trim-path pulse runs to the next hero and lands on the first sung word. Pure function of t.

films.evidence: G1 posters 88-94 on P1; seam test SKOR 80

name: Tittle bounce by inertia
lesson: The i-dot is a separate glyph contour (fontTools export) that rides with its letter; when the letter stops at the end of its snap the dot keeps the momentum: ~32 px up, falls, 2-frame squash 1.22x0.78 on contact, one rebound at restitution 0.35 (~8 frames). A dot that appears before its body (fading in on its own) reads as a floating speck.

films.evidence: video-8 motion test frames 2.27-2.53 s

name: Counters change per frame, not per sub-frame
lesson: With sub-frame motion blur a rolling counter shows several numbers inside one frame (ghost digits). Quantise its time to the frame (round(t*30)/30) so every sub-frame draws the same value.

films.evidence: 9.546 ghost fixed in check2

name: The reviewer's pen gesture, not his words
lesson: Ikhsan (2026-10-30): his real review quotes stay off screen ('jangan ditampilkan di layar'). Show the gesture of the pen instead (an illegible scribble, a red X, a red tick); the VO carries the meaning.

films.evidence: Ikhsan's note on the video-7 hook preview

name: Seam-time seamless loop
lesson: A loop that is also a song span: pick a bar-aligned span (17 bars) so the groove crosses the seam; every element alive near the seam is a function of seam time (pings, camera push, breath periodic per bar), captions clear before the last frame, sub-frame times wrap. Check: |last - frame 0| equals a neighbour step.

films.evidence: seam diff 2.79 vs neighbours 2.70-2.90; seam test SKOR 80

name: Phrase cuts must change the dominant value
lesson: motion-eye counts cuts by colour histogram only: a camera cut on the same paper field reads as a camera move (video-7 v1: 50 designed cuts, 20 detected, 1.68 cut/10 s). To hold video-2's tempo, alternate the dominant value at phrase cuts inside a section (tight close on a dark print, an ink sheet, a cream board, a black 'silence' card) without adding hues.

films.evidence: video-7 hook: 9 -> 11 detected shots, pacing 6/10 -> 10/10

name: STT check of the TTS take
lesson: Run speech-to-text on every TTS take before placing it: confirms acronyms, brand names and spelled numbers (C-O-A, ISO tujuh belas nol dua lima, 'dot com') were spoken as intended, because the alignment only reflects the input text.

films.evidence: video-6: transcript matched the script word for word; EdigLab heard as 'Ediklab' (normal Indonesian final-g devoicing)

name: SDF window morph (silhouette -> card -> next silhouette)
lesson: One window crosses the whole film: each state is a signed distance field in hero-box px (animal silhouettes from prep.py, an analytic rounded card); a morph is a blend of two fields + grow. Two shapes that barely overlap thin out mid-blend: dilate +38 px x sin(pi k). The photo is painted through the same mask, so the reveal (silhouette fills with the photo, then opens into the card) and the handover (card closes back, re-forms into the next animal) are one move.

films.evidence: G1 motion test SKOR 80; hook preview SKOR 84 vs kiblat, 0 flashes

name: Chorus 2 = chorus 1 from behind, negative gold
lesson: A repeated chorus reuses its rooms without copying: chorus 1's frame at the same musical moment drawn mirrored, soft and dim behind (the room seen from behind), chorus 2's frame as negative monochrome gold in front, ad-libs as big out-of-focus type in the foreground; dark rooms are tinted, paper rooms inverted first.

films.evidence: contact sheet L20-27

name: Sample label relay (spine + portal)
lesson: A product's own record (a lab sample label with barcode + ID) is the persistent object: crooked and lost in the hook, buried in chaos, springs back straight, its status dot is the portal into the brand field, it prints its barcode, becomes a worklist row, the COA number, the tracking code and finally morphs into the CTA button.

films.evidence: video-6 SKOR RASA 92 vs kiblat; poster 8/8

name: Marks that stay (present accent, past pencil)
lesson: Every event leaves a mark on one shared world (hatch, rings, aftershock dots, stamps, routes, crowd). The current section's marks wear its single accent; older marks drop to a pencil mix of ink and field (0.62), so one accent per frame holds; in the outro every mark turns red and the pull-back shows the whole year at once.

films.evidence: v1 review: 1 accent per frame, 4 accent families per film, posters 8/8

name: Halftone auto-shade on folded faces
lesson: Each 3D face's world normal dotted with the direction to a camera-mounted key light: linear(dot, -1, 1, 20, 100) % sets a printed halftone tone (cached dot patterns), so a paper cube darkens in dots as it turns away; dimetric 38/30 instead of true iso, or all three visible faces get the same dot.

films.evidence: SF2/SF3 posters 100

name: Real geodata as the drawing
lesson: Coastlines (Natural Earth 1:10m) and depth/height contours (ETOPO1 1 arc-min, gaussian 1.3, levels -200..-6000 / 300..4000 m) drawn as constant-pixel fat lines give a printed-map texture that holds at every zoom from 3,900 km to street scale; labels get a cartographer's halo in the field colour.

films.evidence: sense: 0 % mud, contrast ink vs field ~81

name: Dual-rate comic panels (60 fps camera, 12 fps print)
lesson: 3D camera travels between comic panels at 60 fps with sub-frame blur; each panel's canvas is repainted once per 12 fps step (boil, hatching, one misregistered plate, letters slam in 2 steps with a diagonal smear); impacts only on shouted words, speed lines at the frame edge for 4 steps; no RGB split (4 colours fails the poster). Leave a panel late and travel 0.3 s or the last slam is never seen.

films.evidence: SF5 poster 100; CORNBREAD frame 64 -> 94 after one plate colour

name: Board truck with speed-matched smear
lesson: Feature beats are spots on one board; the camera trucks between them in 0.34 s (SNAP bezier .8,0,.15,1), right or down along a path, with 12 sub-frames plus a post-pass directional blur equal to the travel in half a frame (comb-free). A whoosh 20 ms before.

films.evidence: video-6: 9 trucks; burst 11->16 %, shot median 2.8->2.5 s, eye jumps 24-25 %

name: The event makes the field change
lesson: The next field grows inside a world disc that starts AT the event: a fire burns the paper to char from the park outward (noisy edge, ember rim, 0.34-0.42 s), a quake wave wipes char back to paper from the epicentre (clean edge, red rim, 0.3 s). Headline ink flips per line exactly when the front passes behind it (screen point -> ground -> distance to the centre).

films.evidence: G1 motion test sense 92; styleframes poster 88-94; v1 SKOR RASA 84 vs kiblat

name: Value flip flooding out of the anchor
lesson: Every phrase cut swaps field and window ink (light<->dark) as a 0.26 s disc flood from the window centre, the camera snapping to a new framing at the same time; handovers flood in the next member's field. A hard edge combs into rings under 10 sub-frames: soft band = 0.35 x edge travel per frame. On flat fields camera pushes barely move pixels; value floods are what raise measured burst.
source: kiblat: value flip under a fixed anchor

films.evidence: hook burst 8 % -> 14-15 %, cuts 1.0 -> 4.1 per 10 s, SKOR 80 -> 84

name: Locked button -> unlock -> portal
lesson: A rule shown as UI: the action button is disabled with a lock, refuses the cursor (kick shake + soft deny SFX) on the spoken 'tidak', unlocks with a latch click when the approval lands, is pressed, and its fill grows into the next section's field (0.22 s, inCubic).

films.evidence: video-6 gate beat 24.6-27.7 s; strip checked, no combing

name: Letterbox rip on the first 808
lesson: A world switch placed on a measured silence (here 9 frames at -53 dB) then the first 808: 2.35:1 bars torn open in 5 frames, zoom-blur suck + pincushion -> barrel, and in the same second lens 85 -> 15 mm, 30 -> 60 fps, shutter 180 -> 90, palette and physics flip. Freeze everything in the silence (contrast of state).

films.evidence: motion test SKOR RASA 88 vs kiblat, max 1 flash/s; G1 approved

name: Paper tear (the director's hand rips the frame)
lesson: Hero transition for a cut-paper world: the hand arrives 0.16 s early, grips a corner, the sheet resists then rips away (dist 2400·k^2.1, lift 0.035, shadow grows), the corner piece drops; 22 sub-frames of motion blur, rip SFX ~5 dB under the VO. Use only at section turns (4 per 90 s).

films.evidence: video-7 hook SKOR RASA 96, full v1 88; frame strips clean (no slab, no seam)

name: Pixel-stretch melt transition
lesson: The frame above a scanline stays, the scanline itself is stretched to the bottom edge; the line rises in 4 f (inCubic) so the photo melts into streaks of its own colours, then the next scene is revealed above a falling line that starts inside its hero (the 29 digits drip). Slams on 12 fps steps must not ramp alpha from 0, or the whole first step is empty.

films.evidence: motion test 3.6 s: SKOR RASA 92 vs kiblat, sense 96, kedip maks 2/s

name: Slot roll with deepening fields
lesson: Three closing words roll up through one slot, each on a deeper field of the brand family (Primary -> Dark -> Navy), check disc spring on each, vertical smear matched to the roll speed; the end card trucks up from below.

films.evidence: video-6 CTA 50.0-54.3 s

name: Hero word shrinks into the next word's label
lesson: A short sung connector (THE, MIXIN', SUV) is the hero while it is sung (no empty frame), then on the next word it shrinks with the same snap into a tracked-out caps label in the corner of the new hero's box; the box auto-fits the measured ink of whichever word it holds.

films.evidence: video-8: removed an empty box 3.45-4.30 s and a near-empty white frame 10.8-11.7 s; motion test sense 84 -> 88

name: Loupe as MAGNET_NULL (proximity rig)
lesson: A visible prop is the null: a watchmaker's loupe rides over the word being sung; letters within 230 px scale ease(length(), 0, R, 1.6, 1) and are pushed out of their line; letters already passed keep half the kick (closest approach, still a pure function of t); punctuation is never kicked.

films.evidence: SF1 poster 88; G1 approved

name: Answer blanked in the caption until said
lesson: In a guessing beat the translated caption names the answer before the VO does. Blank those words as ink bars (karaoke marker still runs over them) and the native name as ???, until the keyword is spoken; the name slam then replaces the caption.

films.evidence: QA 2026-10-31: 'Harimau Korea' readable ~3 s before the reveal

name: Sliced word slam with echo over a blurred replay
lesson: For a rapid spoken list: a hard cut per word; the word is cut into 3 horizontal slices that snap in from opposite sides (expo 16, 1-frame stagger), smeared while fast, with a 3-copy echo; the beat it names replays blurred under an ink (0.88, not 0.7 — that was grey mud) or lime field.

films.evidence: recap 47.7–54.5 s; burst rose to 15 %, colour fields 4 -> 6

name: Chromatic edge blur
lesson: RGB split + blur only toward the frame edges, centre sharp; at rest below the 'optics always on' tell (CA < 0.5 % width), stronger only while fast.

name: Exponential glow (three stacked radii)
lesson: Light falls off exponentially: sum glows at r, 5r and 25–40r (≈1.5 / 0.6 / 0.2, widest tinted); only on real lights (lamp, screen, gem, accent blob), never as default type glow (kiblat neon 1 %).

name: Blur and glow in linear float, lights above 1.0
lesson: 8-bit sRGB blurs give dull grey edges; blur light layers in the linear half-float pipeline and let light layers exceed 1.0 so they bloom like a sensor (motion blur and bloom already accumulate in linear).

name: Pixel sorting tied to speed or light
lesson: Above a luminance threshold, letter pixels collapse into sorted needle streaks only at peak speed or in a bright light (a cause), never as a random glitch preset; bake true sorts.

name: Slit-scan / temporal slicing
lesson: Render K = 8–16 time slices of the type layer and composite per pixel by a gradient/radial/spiral map; whole again when still; small D on words that must be read.

name: Velocity turbulent displace
lesson: Displacement 0 at rest, peak only in the ~4 fastest frames, 0 on landing (letters melt/burn in the wind); a sibling of smear — one per move.

name: Alien physics (inverted gravity, time both ways)
lesson: Negative gravity in bounce(), reversed time pose(T − t) in one region, mirrored folded space — one alien rule per chapter, applied consistently.

name: Brand physics: one T/ζ set per film
lesson: Write the film's physics before its eases (ui T 0.45 ζ 0.85 · hero 0.55/0.7 · heavy 0.8/0.9 · playful 0.4/0.5) and derive every move and its sound from it; heavy arrives late and never bounces.

name: Anticipation: the word hangs, then falls
lesson: Give the slow VO lead-in something to hold: the word hangs on a string and sways, the string snaps on the keyword, ballistic drop with squash, dust from the contact and a 3-frame shake (cause and effect).

films.evidence: replaced 1.8 s of a near-empty frame

name: Impact reaction chain (cause and effect)
lesson: A fall hits the floor: the letter squashes, the floor line bends under it, the camera shakes 3 frames, a spark leaves the contact point — all derived from the same contact time.

name: Three filter questions for open briefs
lesson: Who watches and where · the one feeling after watching · how dense the information is → translate into a recipe; for 'terserah' briefs infer from the kiblat, ask once if unclear, propose 2–3 directions.

name: Steal mechanisms from outside motion graphics
lesson: Borrow mechanisms from watches/cars (ratchet detents), film (rack focus, negative space), architecture and print (folds, grids, late-sun shadows) instead of other people's motion.

name: Daily sketch (45 min, 3–5 s loop, one question)
lesson: One question per sketch, timeboxed, rendered by the same pipeline, measured with eye.py sense, one line learned; don't undo happy accidents — light and compose them; keepers become ledger candidates.

name: Energy map of the script (red / yellow / green)
lesson: Red = peaks (≤ 20 % of lines; the only places for finishing moves and hits), yellow = explanation (clean grid/track-matte), green = connectors/intro/outro (simple, airy).

name: Creativity in prison (extreme constraints)
lesson: When ideas are flat, lock the hands: black/white + one font, or no position property (motion from scale, masks, weight only); a good Eksperimental direction.

name: Kill your darlings pass
lesson: Before any preview ask of every shake, decoration and particle: if deleted, is the message stronger? Delete those; leave one essential move done perfectly.

name: Layered polish, end to end
lesson: Never finish second 1 while second 10 is empty: (1) primary motion, camera and speed graphs across the whole piece, (2) secondary motion and overlaps, (3) optics, light and SFX on the speed peaks.

name: Physical material metaphor decides the motion
lesson: Name the material, not the effect (rubber band, heavy glass plates, microscope focus); font, SFX, light and speed graph follow from it.

name: Synesthesia mapping (sound → letter shape)
lesson: Map measured audio features per frame (onset strength, centroid, roughness) to weight, corner sharpness, stroke jitter or a stepped frame rate; flicker stays ≤ 3/s.

name: Refractive glass panel
lesson: Inside a glass shape redraw what is behind displaced (shift max = scale/2; 4–12 subtle, 20–40 dramatic), blurred 5–10 px, with a 1 px gradient edge; ribbed glass = periodic 1D map.

name: Micro-UI density (timecode, coords, hex, waveform)
lesson: Tiny (≤ 2 % H), low-contrast, edge-placed running data around giant cropped type gives high-density energy; one section only (kiblat crowding ≤ 6 %).

name: Rule-based chaos (emergent agents)
lesson: 2–3 rules instead of keyframes (split on kick, letters repel, canvas shrinks); seeded agents with Nature-of-Code steering; stateful, so bake; keep one readable anchor.

name: Analog resampling (filmed refraction as displacement)
lesson: Film the screen from 2 cm or through water/crumpled plastic, extract frames, use them (contrast up) as a displacement map by frame index — real optics no plugin fakes; needs Ikhsan to shoot it.

name: Gobo shadows drifting over the field
lesson: Blurred (150–300 px) slats/leaves at 15–25 % multiply drifting very slowly; type passes in and out of light so the frame becomes a room; never high contrast across small type.

name: Reaction-diffusion growth from letters
lesson: Gray–Scott in a ping-pong float buffer seeded by the text mask (coral ≈ feed 0.055, kill 0.062); stateful, so bake it; one accent moment per film.

name: Misuse the tool (broken interpolation)
lesson: Feed a tool what it wasn't made for: interpolate two very different glyph SDFs/masks, displace by frame difference, run eases outside 0–1 — datamosh-like melts that can't be drawn by hand.

name: Auto-fit type rig (Spotify Wrapped style)
lesson: Measure the text box every frame: short words stretch to fill (widest wdth that fits, then size), long ones split into boxes; frames and underlines follow the ink box.

films.evidence: only shrink-to-fit inside the staircase blocks; stretch + split not built

name: Optical alignment (ink bounds, hanging punctuation)
lesson: Centre on actualBoundingBox ink, not advance width; hang periods/quotes/◆; nudge open shapes (T V W Y A L) 1–3 % toward their mass; check on a 2× crop.

name: Rim light / sweep that moves with the motion
lesson: A 2–4 px rim on one edge whose angle follows the move direction, plus one light sweep crossing the hero exactly on its settle — reads as metal/glass; hero words only.

name: Effect stacking ('upgrade semua')
lesson: Every arsenal technique stacked = ten motifs, no motif. Max 3 visible signatures per film (motif lock); the arsenal is a menu.

films.note: 'neon sampah… asal jadi, konsepnya tidak menyatu'

name: Liquid merge with SDF smooth-min
lesson: Circle SDFs combined with IQ smooth-min (k ≈ 70–90 px) in a fragment shader; key bloom to saturated chroma only, or a light field washes white.

films.evidence: poster 94; the first render washed the lilac field white through bloom

name: Song re-cut on its own grid
lesson: A music-only film re-cuts the song itself: every segment's offset (song - film) is a whole number of beats, so the grid never drifts; the cut points sit in the gaps between sung words, measured in the vocal band (500-3500 Hz, 20 ms), not at whisper's word starts (they run ~0.15 s early); 25 ms equal-power crossfades, a hard cut-off only where the brief asks.

name: Crammed split-screen door panels

name: One-frame invert impact
lesson: Kiblat signature: 0 one-frame impacts per minute; punch comes from scale, timing and SFX. Never > 3 flashes per second.

name: Random glitch presets (RGB slices, VHS)
lesson: Glitch with no cause reads as generic 'tech'; damage must be structured and caused (pixel sort at peak speed or in light), and never strobe > 3/s.

name: Music with a boom on every beat
lesson: A boom on every beat under the VO; kiblat: 0 % boomy onsets.
